description: A reified 'describes' relation: a source document that describes the study it reports (subject = source, object = study) — the FIRST hop of the provenance spine source → describes → study → grounds → evidence. Maps to the MIRA schema's describesActivity slot (github.com/MIRA-science/schema, mira.yaml on main: slot_uri mira:describesActivity, domain CreativeWork, range Activity; MIRA's SourceDocument is_a CreativeWork and Study mixes in Activity, so source→study is the concrete instance). Together with tech.scios.rrgi.grounds it replaced the older single-hop 'informs' relation (source→evidence), which is DELETED — no informs lexicon exists, and the spine is the only source→evidence path extractors write (MIRA's own direct link, evidence → source document, is accepted beside it since 2026-10-03 as tech.scios.rrgi.sourceDocument): MIRA inserts the study activity between the source and the evidence it grounds. RRGI's intentional divergence (matching supports): subject/object are dual-addressed via com.atproto.repo.strongRef (uri + cid) instead of a bare at-uri, so the edge pins exact content versions and cannot rot. NOTE: no upstream atproto lexicon exists for this type yet; authored ahead of upstream from the MIRA schema, intended to be proposed back.

subject.description: Dual-addressed reference (URI + CID) to the describing node (the source document). RRGI divergence from upstream's bare at-uri: com.atproto.repo.strongRef requires both uri and cid, so the CID is mandatory.

object.description: Dual-addressed reference (URI + CID) to the described node (the study). See subject: RRGI divergence, CID mandatory.

description.description: Optional elaboration: how the source describes or reports this study.
